checks.name: Bus voltage magnitudes against the PSS/E solution
checks.reference: PSS/E 33 load flow report RTSOP_PSSE_Hooman.txt of the RTS-GMLC repository (https://github.com/GridMod/RTS-GMLC/blob/3ece0d3725c844056132393ee252b3083dd4eab4/RTS_Data/FormattedData/PSSE/RTSOP_PSSE_Hooman.txt, sha256 75080c127202662df85166ed66b995a0f68f40062092a7bf539d24b5d083b106, retrieved 2026-11-18), provided by Hooman Ghaffarzadeh on 8 November 2017, made from RTS-GMLC_Hooman.raw of the same folder (https://github.com/GridMod/RTS-GMLC/blob/3ece0d3725c844056132393ee252b3083dd4eab4/RTS_Data/FormattedData/PSSE/RTS-GMLC_Hooman.raw, sha256 a7cdbef898d5c76c9ee05ba70e43a6266d49308eadcad56ae55acc0263c55da7). PSS/E printed it after solving RTS-GMLC_Hooman.raw, which holds the same network and dispatch as RTS-GMLC.RAW (compared by scripts/crosscheck_pf.py report: every bus, every generator in service, every branch and transformer, apart from what a power flow does not use: the stored state, the settings of generators out of service and the end a branch with no tap is listed from); TENSA did not compute it. It prints a voltage to four decimals, an angle to two and the power of a generator to 0.1 MW
